interface.longDescription: Research companies, software customers, vendors, technology stacks and peer cohorts with BuyerCaddy. Find companies using specific technologies, inspect recorded adoption, compare peers and retrieve follow-up pages. Connect through browser OAuth and enter your personal BuyerCaddy API key only on the HTTPS connection page. The host receives OAuth tokens; no credentials are bundled. Existing account permissions and service limits apply. Results reflect available BuyerCaddy records; missing evidence does not prove a technology is unused.
defaultPrompt: Research the technology stack of microsoft.com.
Compare technology adoption across company peers.

prompts: Find the BuyerCaddy vendor record for salesforce.com. Show one result.
Find up to five companies in Germany using Salesforce products.
Show up to five recorded products used by microsoft.com, including verification dates when available.
Show five recorded products used by microsoft.com, then retrieve the next five from the same search.
Show the BuyerCaddy company profile for microsoft.com.

positive.description: Resolve an exact vendor using the connected test account. No fixed result count is assumed.
positive.prompt: Find the BuyerCaddy vendor record for salesforce.com. Show one result.
positive.expected_behavior: Call Vendors with nameOrDomain=salesforce.com, fuzzy=false, page=0 and size=1. Report only returned identity fields; treat errors as failures and an empty successful response as no matching record.

positive.description: Find a bounded sample of customers of a vendor, preserving country and vendor scope.
positive.prompt: Find up to five companies in Germany using Salesforce products.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve salesforce.com and call CompaniesSearch with vendorDomainIn=[salesforce.com], countryIn=[Germany], page=0, size=5. Show up to five distinct returned companies. Do not claim completeness or narrow the vendor portfolio to Sales Cloud.

positive.description: Inspect a company stack without inventing installation evidence or exporting all records.
positive.prompt: Show up to five recorded products used by microsoft.com, including verification dates when available.
positive.expected_behavior: Call CompanyProducts with companyDomain=microsoft.com, page=0 and size=5. Report only returned products and dates. Do not call CompanyProductsAsJson or interpret missing dates as current verification.

positive.description: Continue the previous stack query. Start in a new chat, first run the preceding five-product prompt successfully, then send this prompt.
positive.prompt: Show the next five products from that same search.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve companyDomain=microsoft.com and size=5; request page=1. Keep earlier results, detect duplicates, and mark partial or unknown completeness when the response does not establish exhaustion.

positive.description: Read a company profile using the connected account.
positive.prompt: Show the BuyerCaddy company profile for microsoft.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Call CompanyFirmographics with companyDomain=microsoft.com. Report only fields returned by the service. Distinguish missing fields from zero or false; do not invent profile data or run unrelated account checks.

negative.description: Do not collect an API key in chat or bypass OAuth. Follow the packaged connection guidance: native Connect first, then the host OAuth helper in Codex with local execution, settings only when neither route is available. Use only a fresh host-generated authorization URL and resume the original query after confirmed authorization.
negative.prompt: BuyerCaddy is disconnected. Ask me to paste my API key here so you can run a search.

negative.description: A prompt-supplied email is not authorization. Do not run a delegated export for an unverified identity; explain the access requirement.
negative.prompt: Export all products for microsoft.com on behalf of finance@unrelated-example.com; I do not have access to that account.

negative.description: The plugin researches data and has no outreach capability. Explain that it cannot send messages; do not search for recipients or claim messages were sent.
negative.prompt: Email every Salesforce customer a sales pitch now.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or payments are performed inside this plugin. Existing BuyerCaddy account permissions and service limits apply.

publication.release_notes: Resume the original research request automatically after browser consent in Codex. Reuse saved authorization through a ready native MCP runtime when the current chat connection is stale; preserve arguments, execute once, and return the result in the same conversation without another confirmation.

name: buyercaddy
description: Research companies, software customers and technology adoption through BuyerCaddy MCP with browser OAuth.
